sentences.en: The temperature fell five degrees centigrade below zero yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天温度下降了5摄氏度低于零度。

sentences.en: The temperature went down to minus ten degrees centigrade last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚温度降到零下十摄氏度。

sentences.en: Do not expose to temperatures above fifty centigrade.
sentences.zh: 不要暴露在五十摄氏度以上的温度中。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：centi（百）+grad（度）+e→百分度的
